scope: Payload-free controlled movement witnesses and executable-derived input facts; raw captures remain ignored.

inputConditioning.quarterContext: Only reached after current magnitude exceeds 0.9 and the previous history sample does not; scans earlier magnitude history for a value below 0.25 and raises an input-event bit.
inputConditioning.quarterVerdict: Confirmed as a rapid-stick/history threshold; rejected as the ordinary locomotion activation or dead-zone threshold.

timing.nominalDescription: 60 Hz is NTSC/game-math shorthand, not a measured 60.000 Hz wall clock.

diagnosticUpdateCounter.use: Exact-update pacing for normal/jump/turn local captures only.
diagnosticUpdateCounter.boundary: Resets or stalls in the L2 strafe witness; not a universal retail frame counter and not part of the committed capture contract.

jump.contactFinding: Position clamps to the ground before state 7 returns to state 0; +0xF8 can retain the pre-contact downward recurrence for that sampled update.

turning.normalFacingRule: Live-player +0xF8 converges to planar travel heading during ordinary locomotion.

rightCardinalWitness.note: Camera-relative right is not exactly a geometric 90-degree world turn from the savestate heading.

reverseWitness.easing: Large repeated steps during reversal then tapering steps approaching travel heading; exact recurrence not recovered from these witnesses.

l2.interpretation: Same planar speed cap as normal movement while facing is held approximately pi/2 from travel, establishing a distinct strafe basis.

fieldFindings.globalPositionVsLivePosition: Matches on settled samples; occasional one-update skew appears because the two PINE reads are not atomic.
fieldFindings.globalF0F4: Stayed zero during these controlled planar traces; do not treat +0xF0/+0xF4 as the complete planar velocity state.
fieldFindings.globalF8: Tracks vertical motion recurrence and ground bias, including jump rise/fall values.
fieldFindings.livePlayerF8: Yaw, corroborated by normal alignment with travel and L2's approximately pi/2 facing/travel separation.

limitations: The witnesses use digital full-stick keyboard bindings; partial-stick movement response was not dynamically swept.
The exact normal-turn easing recurrence is not recovered; live-object reads can be one update out of phase with player-global reads.
The L2 witness identifies a strafe basis but does not recover the complete lock-strafe state machine or camera contract.
Raw PINE traces, screenshots, PCSX2 binaries/configuration and retail media are intentionally not committed.
provenance: authorized SCUS-97353 retail execution in a disposable PCSX2/PINE setup
